name: SILICON2 Co., Ltd.
summary: SILICON2 Co., Ltd. engages in the distribution of cosmetics products worldwide. The company offers logistics agency services for direct to customer companies; logistic services; marketing services for brand and influencers; and distributes korean pop albums and merchandise. It also operates a health and beauty store; and stylekorean.com, an e-commerce platform for cosmetics products. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
